caption: 01 · TASTE — What exactly is being claimed?. Separate a general sensibility from a named mark, protected work, registered design, confidential process, contractual promise, or misleading commercial representation. Precision prevents cultural grievance from being mistaken for a settled legal result.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: 02 · TRACE — What entered the process?. Keep a source log for references, licensed assets, model and tool versions, prompts, human selections, rejected outputs, edits, and final approvals. The record supports accountability without proving a legal conclusion on its own.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what entered the process? within Can Taste Be Owned in the Age of Generative AI?.

caption: 03 · TRANSFORM — Where is human judgment visible?. Describe the problem, constraints, alternatives, selection criteria, arrangement, revision, and final expressive choices. Avoid claiming that effort alone creates protection; the purpose is to preserve an accurate creative record.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping where is human judgment visible? within Can Taste Be Owned in the Age of Generative AI?.
